name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 10 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-05-02, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.07 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
